newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's former king Michael has started his tour in Western capitals to seek support for Romania's early admisssion in NATO.

* The 1997 draft budget is an anti-reform budget, former prime minister Nicolae Vacaroiu said. He also said the farming, health and sport sectors would get a smaller share of the budget. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
